[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/1d9d5705b03dd8aa581252ec836f700bd3de7273.jpg[/img]

Every survivor has a story, but few are as vital as the Mule’s.

A seasoned trader, the Mule was the first to open shop near the church after the Cataclysm. Since then he has built a network of trading posts that keep scattered settlements alive. Calm, fair, and always on the move, he earned the trust of many without ever pledging to a side.

For you, the Mule is more than just a merchant. He is your access to supplies, rare items, and crucial information. Through him you can trade resources that decide whether a camp survives or collapses.

The Mule is the quiet force behind survival. When he appears, it means opportunity, stability, and hope in a world where those are in short supply.

notes.title: Surviving the Freeze
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/f9c50f9d465b34cdb5a8d33e28d28738627fb575.png[/img]

Hey Survivors!

The eternal winter has arrived, and with it comes a brutal test of endurance. We're diving into the core survival mechanics of Permafrost - the systems that shape every step of your journey through the cold, broken world.

[h3]The Cold Will Kill You[/h3]
The world is frozen solid - not just cold, but lethal.
Managing body temperature is critical. Stay exposed too long and you’ll freeze to death. Some areas, known as Cold Zones, hold rare resources but come with an extreme risk. You’ll need the right gear and timing to survive them.

[h3]Scavenge. Craft. Adapt.[/h3]
In a world stripped of comfort, everything you need must be found or made.
Scavenge ruins for pre-collapse tech, batteries, metal scraps, and fuel. Craft tools, weapons, clothing, and other essentials. Your survival depends on how well you adapt to what’s left behind.

[h3]Shelter is Survival[/h3]
Your first task is to secure shelter - not just for warmth, but to store supplies and begin building a future. Restore abandoned structures, reinforce walls, heat your base, and expand over time. Eventually, you'll be able to farm food, craft advanced gear, and offer safety to other survivors.

[h3]Your Companion in the Wasteland[/h3]
Early in your journey, you'll rescue a loyal dog companion.
This four-legged friend is more than a morale boost: it can warn you of threats, help carry items, and detect dangers before it’s too late. You’ll quickly learn to rely on your companion in the harshest conditions.

[h3]From Scrap to Firepower[/h3]
At first, you’ll rely on primitive weapons - makeshift bows, or modified tools.
But as you scavenge parts and learn old-world techniques, you’ll gain access to firearms - shotguns, rifles, and other proper weapons to deal with both wild predators and human threats.

[h3]Exploration & Risk[/h3]
The map is large, open, and unforgiving. On foot, you'll explore frozen cities, forests, and industrial ruins in search of materials, tech, and shelter.
But every step away from safety is a gamble. Time, temperature, and threats are always ticking.

[h3]Survive Together[/h3]
Permafrost supports online co-op for up to four players.
Whether you team up with friends or go solo, survival is never easy - but it’s always meaningful. Share supplies, build together, and defend your shelter from the cold and the chaos.

notes.title: Understanding Resources
notes.notes:
In Permafrost, survival hinges on how well you manage your resources. Every scrap you gather has value, whether for crafting essential tools, repairing gear, or building shelters to protect against the harsh cold.
It goes without saying that natural resources such as trees are essential for building and therefore crafting stone axes early on are crucial to your loadout.

Key resources like food and fuel are vital—and once shelter is built, you’ll need to consider how to cultivate crops as another dietary resource.  Hunting elusive prey such as deer with a rifle or bow can help sustain you, and scavenging the ruins of civilization for supplies to sustain your character can also provide materials and resources that can go a long way in helping you progress.

Rarer materials, such as Moonrock, unlock advanced crafting opportunities, but this is an extremely rare resource to come by. Resources are key to your survival and how you manage them, you’ll learn to prioritize your limited inventory space and plan what resources are the most vital to you.

Strategize wisely — your survival depends on it!

notes.title: Frostbitten Foes: Unravelling Factions in Permafrost
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/cfe1f24efc7685cd508171f274cbb7492260acca.png[/img]

In today’s news post we’ll dip into the heart of post-apocalyptic rivalries and how you can survive the human element in Permafrost.

Rival factions battle for supremacy amidst the icy ruins to build out the narrative in Permafrost, in a world plunged into chaos with civil order now just a memory you have careful choices to make as you endure the harsh realities of the frozen wilderness. In Permafrost you have the ability to go it alone or you can choose to formulate alliances that fit your outlook. Forming alliances affect player progression and adds another layer to the gameplay.

The Moon Cult is one such rival faction you may cross paths with, you’ll see their handy work and how they use icicles to display their unfortunate victims, they are not to be taken lightly.

Will you work alone or look for like-minded souls to forge an alliance with to increase your chances of survival.

notes.title: New Area: Exploring the Urban District
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/d10cca0ae8b1b8d28fd2640c7580687d08ec1033.png[/img]

Hello Survivors,

We are delighted to share the next step on our development journey with you. We’ve been hard at work at expanding not only the gameplay systems but the world of Permafrost and can reveal the new area “Urban District” to you.
 
Here you step out of the rural landscape into a city area with apartment buildings, condos and tower blocks.
If you are willing to take the risk and enter this war-torn district with its rivalling factions fighting for supremacy, you will be handsomely rewarded.
 
But there is no time for sightseeing, even though the transformation from a once vivid area buzzing with the hustle and bustle of city life into a white landscape marked by ice and snow is a beauty to behold. Not to mention the memorable characters you will meet along the way.
 
Enter the buildings, search for quality tools and blueprints and make sure that you and your four-legged friend survive, Then and only then can you try and bring society together again and overcome the Permafrost.
 
We can’t wait to tell you more about Permafrost in the weeks and months to come. So, stay tuned, don’t forget to wishlist the game (if you haven’t done so already) and join the discussion on the official Discord server.

notes.title: Your Best Friend
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/ff27b309b87a99565bb85740a2eece887b314a2f.png[/img]

A few minutes after you start your Permafrost adventure, your trusty german shepherd will be by your side, ready to make surviving in this harsh world a little easier and a lot more heartwarming.

Your dog is an invaluable part of the adventure. It can carry extra items for you, acting as a trusty pack mule when your inventory fills up. Whether you’re scavenging for resources, hauling loot back to your base, or just want to travel lighter, your canine companion has you covered.

And calling your dog is as easy as blowing a whistle. No matter how far you stray or how treacherous the terrain gets, one sharp sound will have your faithful friend trotting back to your side. It’s a simple mechanic, but one we believe adds a comforting sense of connection as you navigate the icy dangers of Permafrost.

But we’re just getting started. In future updates, your dog’s role will grow even more dynamic. Soon, your companion will be able to warn you of dangers lurking nearby, bring you loot it finds in the environment, help you locate hidden resources, and even guide you through the treacherous landscape.

Our goal is to make the dog not just a tool for survival but a true companion—one that players will bond with as they brave the challenges of Permafrost. 


Don't forget to put your dog along with Permafrost on your wishlist!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/e662dd777a162327fb05e1582e9ce6150c5c31c1.png[/img]

In Permafrost we’re designing a world forever changed by the ‘shattering’, a world altering natural disaster that has plunged the world into a new ice age where the temperature and overall climate represents a permanent winter.

In designing the game, creating a contrast between the natural wilderness and man-made architecture is also an important aspect to change up tactical play and the game's visual appeal.

Today we wanted to give you a sneak peek at the solar facility. This modern facility complete with damaged and distorted solar panels, was once an active energy generating location which now lies derelict and will be one of many unique places to explore in the game. Check out the shots below.

notes.title: Crafting Essentials - Moonrock
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/c78e779122affbf209774041cbcbe2b1a30d6edb.png[/img]

The story of Permafrost is set in the wake of the cataclysmic ‘shattering', an apocalyptic moon phase phenomenon where humanity finds itself teetering on the brink of extinction as the world succumbs to an eternal deep freeze.
 
Following the catastrophic events that shattered the moon, fragments of its remains fell to Earth, including a significant moon rock near one of the forest areas. This resource possesses unknown capabilities but has already proven valuable for crafting high-quality, highly durable tools and equipment. Its arrival led to concerns about potential contamination, which, combined with the harsh conditions, prompted the military to abandon their post.
 
Not to be confused with another valuable resource, coal, the moon rock's mysterious properties and utility have made it a desirable resource in the post-apocalyptic world, inspiring hope but also fear.

notes.title: Permafrost - 10,000 Polls, What Comes Next?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/18eb28c25f909300be11fdfd20fc9620cea7f5bc.png[/img]
 
We know that many of you are curious to know what comes next for Permafrost, the demo was a good starting point for identifying what matters most to you as players for the full game. Over 10,000 of you submitted feedback on the demo and our focus will concentrate based on the points raised and the comments we received, this is what we will work on for the Early Access launch.
 
[h3]Technical Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are optimizing the full game to reduce FPS drops and stuttering
[*] We will address memory leaks and performance degradation during longer play sessions
[*] We will look to Improve overall optimization, especially for lower-end hardware
[/list]
 
[h3]Core Gameplay Systems[/h3]
[list]
[*] Looking to improve functionality where Inventory Management and making backpack switching becomes more intuitive
[*] Fix glitches with item transfers and storage for the EA version
[*] Improve the overall inventory interface experience for players
[/list]
 
[h3]Building System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix camera view issues when building in small spaces
[*] Make structure placement more precise and intuitive for players
[*] Address issues with building degradation (consider making it toggleable)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/210c7e5ce4fcd5796a62342ab14d29d1cd123103.jpg[/img]
 
[h3]Multiplayer Experience[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix connection issues and rubber banding that were apparent in the demo
[*] Address player synchronization problems for the EA version
[*] Fix bugs where players get kicked from sessions for no apparent reason
[*] Improve the dog companion system, especially in multiplayer
[/list]
 
[h3]User Interface and Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Smooth out control system
[*] Make the UI more user-friendly, functional and intuitive
[/list]
 
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Address issues with backpack interactions
[*] Fix glitches when searching bodies for loots and resources
[*] Resolve sound issues some players experienced in the demo for EA version
[*] Fix instances where players can get stuck in textures or environment
[/list]
 
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add a proper saving system!
[*] Polish and improve animation
[/list]
 
We’ll keep you all updated on the progress and look forward to sharing new insights with you all as we progress.

Keep the feedback coming in and join the Discord to stay updated.

notes.title: New Permafrost Demo Update: Fixes and Enhancements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/edc8b4b17a804536d239c8ffa8bb22549b5d9b67.png[/img]

Fellow survivors, 

we’re excited to roll out a new update for the Permafrost demo, bringing key fixes and enhancements to make survival in the frozen apocalypse even more immersive. This update addresses performance improvements, stability tweaks, and various quality-of-life changes based on your continued feedback.

A huge thank you to everyone who has shared their thoughts and insights with us. Your feedback is invaluable in shaping Permafrost! Dive back in, explore more of the demo, and let us know what you think.

Keep the conversation going over on our Discord and be sure to wishlist the game on steam.

[h2]Changelog for Steam Demo (0.20.4.611-demo) - 28.10.24[/h2]
 
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Bear boss controller and behavior tree.
[*] Raised deer awareness with immediate reaction to player sighting.
[*] Rabbit trap crafting with new resource costs.
[*] 16 new patterns for character customization.
[*] Quick slots are now visible on the HUD.
[*] More icicles are added to House Camp and other locations for enhanced visuals.
[*] More responsive freezing endurance vignette effects.
[/list]
 
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiple instances of assets optimized, improving overall performance and visual fidelity resulting in significant decrease on VGPU (from 6 GB to 4,3 GB in recent tests) which should improve performance and decrease the number of crashes.
[*] Various bugs in crafting and inventory UI include fixes to crafting tooltips and actions.
[*] Multiple localizations and quest marker updates.
[*] Resolved issues with projectile handling and collisions (arrows won't go through bushes).
[*] Fixed the camera shake and sounds related to firearms.
[*] The player won't count achievement progress when he dies in cold zones.
[*] Weapon trajectories fix and user interface cleanups in the inventory systems.
[*] The minimum random encounter spawn distances have been adjusted significantly.
[*] Tweaked crafting systems for better multiplayer interaction.
[*] Cleanups in the character creator UI and adjusted patterns to reduce visual clutter.
[*] Video setting "Motion Blur OFF" can cause display issues with some hardware configurations.
[/list]
 
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Occasional client synchronization problems with player movement after the game starts.
[*] Persistent minor bugs related to character status and interactions are yet to be fully resolved.
[*] Interacting with workbenches with no roof above can corrupt this instance of workbenches.
[*] Some trees cannot be chopped down.
[*] Performance drops and sometimes frequent hitches can occur, especially when playing co-op mode along with “Out of video memory trying to allocate a rendering resource” crash.
[*] Occasionally the Clients lose quest markers during gameplay.
[*] Sometimes Robyn Quest Marker can move outside the demo territory, despite Robyn staying in the same place.
[*] The effects of weather changes appear inconsistent for Host & Clients.
[*] Difficulty balancing is not final (e.g. hunger, energy, dmg dealt by animals).
[*] The Save System is currently not implemented.
[*] New players will see the character creator shaders loading longer than expected.
[*] Some in-game text (ex. hunger, freezing endurance) has problems with localization.
[*] Trees flicker when the client is far away from the host.
[*] Animals can stop moving when far away from the host.
[/list]

notes.title: Permafrost - The Adventure of Ice and Frost at Steam NEXT Fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/abffe3a31ccf38a1a9a9eb7eb33e9e8bd8809678.png[/img]

Greetings, brave survivor and master of the frozen wilderness!

A chilled challenge awaits you! Permafrost is taking part in Steam NEXT Fest and bringing the cold right into your room. Are you ready to face the merciless eternal winter? Build, hunt, and survive in a world trapped in a sub-zero apocalpse. Every breath freezes, every decision can lead to your downfall. Every little detail counts here - from your choice of equipment to your plan to save yourself from freezing to death.

The arctic-like climate has no mercy for the hesitant and the faint-hearted! Prepare yourself well, because this demo will demand a lot from you. Test your limits and see if you have what it takes to survive.

Put on your thickest woollen socks, pack your hottest drinks and prepare for the challenge of your life, survivor! We await you in the unforgiving realm of Permafrost - at the Steam NEXT Fest!

Be on your guard in the post-apocalyptic world of Permafrost, ruled by an endless winter. After a devastating catastrophe, the earth has become a wasteland of ice, snow and the pitiful remains of human civilisation.

Greetings, frost walkers!

A world frozen to the bone is the substance of the Permafrost experience. You will encounter horrible weather conditions, dangerous animals or cultists and will try to hide in ice-bound buildings. It is important that in those moments of struggle you will also be able to feel the beauty of this fractured, but magnificent environment.

notes.title: Permafrost Gear - The boon of protection!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/ad147486580af0c2312c4a791553be2717e0dbc2.png[/img]

Hello there, chilled survivors!

The world of Permafrost is frigid, in some places even downright extreme. We're not going to talk about thermodynamics and entropy now, that would be too much of a stretch. Just know that you could freeze to death very quickly if you don't protect yourself properly.

That's why we're introducing you to a few things from Permafrost that can improve your survival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/821225f9663846df1da80285799bac4f16b57e70.jpg[/img]
[b]Brazier[/b]
A small structure from scrap where you can throw all kinds of things to act as fuel. Warm up here before venturing into cold zones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/5c9f63c90ab481794a9dd4a671230570b9ac7f09.jpg[/img]
[b]Military Backpack[/b]
A large-sized backpack belonged to the military forces before they went south. In dangerous times, the more you can carry, the longer you can survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/2cd344ded5e29f10b60b355985017d3de2bce0fb.jpg[/img]
[b]Bolt-action Rifle[/b]
Warmth requires energy. Food provides this energy. Hunting is vital in an extreme environment, so you need a tool for hunting. It also protects you from things out there in the cold. The largest bullet calibre means the greatest firepower. However, it has one drawback: it only allows a single shot, requiring you to reload the chamber to shoot again. Make sure you aim well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/c523e97958fc95d14fd61ce21d1201e748dea73d.jpg[/img]
[b]Improvised Tent[/b]
Crafted from gifts of nature and remains left by people, you can create a small but sufficient resting place to regenerate and wait out the snowfall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028984/f7dddf42653545a831a05d927e61de850b73c358.jpg[/img]
[b]Scrap Axe[/b]
You can make all kinds of tools from scraps of crumbled civilization. These tools are useful for chopping trees and destroying furniture for resources.
  
What would you take with you if you were travelling to an extremely cold place? Write to us here, on Discord or on our social media channels!

Greetings from the chill outside

notes.title: Are you ready for the never-ending winter?
notes.notes:
We hope you like it snowy, cold and dangerous. Because all that awaits you in [b]Permafrost[/b]!

It’s the year 2035. An apocalyptic catastrophe has struck mankind, covering the earth in a sea of ice and snow. In this chaos, it's up to you to survive. Build a base with infrastructure, collect resources, craft tools and search for other survivors.

Discover the secret of the eternal ice age. Roam the ruins of civilization and be on your guard against the dangers of this devastated world, where extreme cold is just one of many deadly dangers. Beware of enemies, whether they are two-legged or four-legged!

Speaking of four legs: Every brave survivor needs a loyal companion! Your dog warns you of dangers and helps you carry objects. Treat him well! Dealing with other survivors, on the other hand, is at your discretion, and you will be faced with morally difficult decisions as you build your life. Your friends can also become part of this bitterly cold story, as you can experience Permafrost both alone and with up to three friends.

Are you ready to face the cold and survive?
 
The teams from Spacerocket Games and Toplitz Productions
